desc: Derive the exact formula for the number of alternating completions given remaining odd/even counts and the required next parity.
Design the lexicographic unranking procedure that tries unused values in ascending order and updates `k`.
Specify efficient data structures and parity/count updates suitable for `n <= 100`.
Handle invalid `k`, impossible parity configurations, and count capping safely.
Run the implementation against all three examples and boundary cases, then fix any discrepancy found.
